sample_selection: Entire prior Stage24 jointly-source-verified future gross 2x winner set, including all 4 gross5x and 1 gross10x as SAME underlying cohort repeated thresholds. Explicit hindsight-selected diagnostic, not all-market unbiased recall.

source_provenance.raw_hourly_baselines_and_cross_hour: from original six SHA-gated zipped JSON every winner
source_provenance.minute: Binance official Spot daily 1m archives and publisher CHECKSUM SHA256 for 60h centered on first historical threshold-crossing 1h interval

censor_policy: Archive incomplete or hourly-minute mismatch must be reported as censored, never no WATCH or failed trade
causal_order: Find first verified minute HIGH in first crossing 1h only; event-local scanner V4 uses closed 1m at 3m intervals and past rolling24h volume; WATCH <= crossing minute classified early (note timestamp ties lower confidence)
horizon: Only 12h event-aligned around known first cross; NOT full continuous seven-day V4 monitoring
mandatory_outputs: all 45 event identities and source proofs
5x and 10x same underlying duplicates not counted independent
comparison with Stage24 frozen early 12h events
future_policy: Do not trade, alert, create new autonomous monitor or declare precision/winrate from posthoc positive cohort. Follow up genuine 168h continuous full-market with ordinary cases if hypothesis needs validation.
